competitor_evidence.text: KLA provides process control and yield management solutions that are essential for semiconductor manufacturers' success.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: positioning the process control and yield management solution we provide as an essential enabler of their success.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA's semiconductor customers operate in the major semiconductor device manufacturing markets: memory and foundry/logic.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our semiconductor customers generally operate in one or both of the major semiconductor device manufacturing markets: memory and foundry/logic.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA's R&D activities involve the development of process control and process-enabling solutions for front end semiconductors and advanced packaging.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: the development of process control and process-enabling solutions for front end semiconductors and advanced packaging.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA's advanced packaging business is experiencing significant growth due to increasing complexity and value of semiconductor packages for AI and HPC applications.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: increasing complexity and value of semiconductor packages, particularly for AI and HPC applications, is also driving significant growth in our advanced packaging business.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA invests significantly in product R&D to maintain its competitive position in semiconductor and electronics technologies.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We make significant investments in product R&D for the timely development of new products and enhancements necessary to maintain our competitive position.

competitor_evidence.text: The semiconductor industry is experiencing market expansion and diversification driven by high-performance computing and data centers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The semiconductor industry continues to experience market expansion and diversification.

competitor_evidence.text: Demand for advanced semiconductor technologies, particularly at the 2-nanometer node, is increasing and supports AI-related investments.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Demand for advanced semiconductor technologies, particularly at the 2-nanometer node, where investment levels and process control intensity are increasing, continues to support AI-related investments.

competitor_evidence.text: KLA's R&D centers are located in multiple countries including the U.S., U.K., India, China, Singapore, and Israel.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our primary R&D centers are located in the U.S., United Kingdom (“U.K.”), India, China, Singapore and Israel.

competitor_evidence.text: Inspection and review tools are used to identify, locate, characterize, review, and analyze defects on various surfaces of patterned and unpatterned wafers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Inspection and review tools are used to identify, locate, characterize, review, and analyze defects on various surfaces of patterned and unpatterned wafers.

competitor_evidence.text: Metrology systems are used to measure pattern dimensions, film thickness(es), film stress, layer-to-layer alignment, pattern placement, surface topography and electro-optical properties for wafers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Metrology systems are used to measure pattern dimensions, film thickness(es), film stress, layer-to-layer alignment, pattern placement, surface topography and electro-optical properties for wafers.

competitor_evidence.text: Chemical process control equipment qualifies incoming supplies, manages tool inputs, adjusts chamber/bath conditions and monitors process waste.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Chemical process control equipment qualifies incoming supplies, manages tool inputs, adjusts chamber/bath conditions and monitors process waste.

competitor_evidence.text: Wired and wireless sensor wafers and reticles provide comprehensive data used to visualize, diagnose and control process conditions in the equipment used to manufacture chips and reticles.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wired and wireless sensor wafers and reticles provide comprehensive data used to visualize, diagnose and control process conditions in the equipment used to manufacture chips and reticles.

competitor_evidence.text: Wafer defect inspection, review and metrology systems are used to help wafer/substrate manufacturers manage quality throughout the wafer fabrication process by detecting defects, characterizing surface quality and assessing wafer geometry.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wafer defect inspection, review and metrology systems are used to help wafer/substrate manufacturers manage quality throughout the wafer fabrication process by detecting defects, characterizing surface quality and assessing wafer geometry.

competitor_evidence.text: Reticle inspection and metrology systems help reticle blank, patterned optical reticle, patterned EUV reticle, and chip manufacturers identify defects, pattern placement errors, and process issues during reticle manufacturing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Reticle inspection and metrology systems help reticle blank, patterned optical reticle, patterned EUV reticle, and chip manufacturers identify defects, pattern placement errors, and process issues during reticle manufacturing.

competitor_evidence.text: Wafer inspection and metrology systems for advanced wafer-level packaging help packaging manufacturers detect, resolve and monitor excursions to provide greater control of quality for improved device performance.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Wafer inspection and metrology systems for advanced wafer-level packaging help packaging manufacturers detect, resolve and monitor excursions to provide greater control of quality for improved device performance.

competitor_evidence.text: Chemistry process monitoring systems analyze and monitor wet chemicals used in wafer-level packaging (WLP), panel-level packaging (PLP), and IC substrates.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Chemistry process monitoring systems analyze and monitor wet chemicals used in wafer-level packaging (WLP), panel-level packaging (PLP), and IC substrates.

competitor_evidence.text: Software solutions centralize and analyze the data produced by inspection, metrology and process systems for chip, wafer, reticle and packaging manufacturing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Software solutions centralize and analyze the data produced by inspection, metrology and process systems for chip, wafer, reticle and packaging manufacturing.

competitor_evidence.text: These solutions provide run-time process control, defect excursion identification, process corrections and defect classification to accelerate yield learning rates and reduce production risk.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: These solutions provide run-time process control, defect excursion identification, process corrections and defect classification to accelerate yield learning rates and reduce production risk.
